employers.cultureDescription:
Rkavach fosters a security-first, innovation-driven culture where learning, collaboration, and ownership are highly valued. The team operates with a strong emphasis on:

Continuous improvement and learning
Transparency and accountability
Customer-first problem solving
Fast execution with high-quality standards
Security as a shared responsibility
employers.about: To simplify cybersecurity for modern organizations by providing accessible, reliable, and actionable security solutions that empower teams to protect their digital assets effectively.
employers.mission: To simplify cybersecurity for modern organizations by providing accessible, reliable, and actionable security solutions that empower teams to protect their digital assets effectively.
employers.vision: To become the go-to global platform for end-to-end cybersecurity management, enabling businesses of all sizes to operate securely in an increasingly complex digital world.

employers.cultureDescription: We foster a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and collaboration. Our team comprises seasoned professionals with over two decades of industry experience, working hand in hand to develop customized and cost-effective security strategies that align with specific needs.
employers.about: Rivedix Technology Solutions is dedicated to empowering organizations with comprehensive cybersecurity and data privacy services. Our expertise spans across various domains, including auditing, Data Protection Officer (DPO) as a service, virtual Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) and fractional CISO services, gap analysis, risk management, security training, compliance, auditing and third-party risk management. Overview
We are seeking an enthusiastic AIGP (AI Governance & Policy) Trainer to join our development team at an entry level. This role offers an exciting opportunity to design, develop, and deliver training programs that educate professionals on AI governance, security best practices, and policy implementation. You will work with cutting-edge technologies while helping organizations build a culture of AI security awareness and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop comprehensive training curricula focused on AI governance, security protocols, and organizational policy frameworks

• Create engaging training materials including presentations, documentation, case studies, and hands-on exercises for diverse audiences

• Deliver training sessions to technical and non-technical stakeholders, adapting content to different experience levels and learning styles

• Collaborate with cybersecurity and policy teams to ensure training content aligns with industry standards and emerging threats

• Gather feedback from training participants and continuously improve course content and delivery methods

• Stay current with AI security trends, governance frameworks, and regulatory requirements to maintain training relevance

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals, including risk management, threat assessment, and security controls

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly

• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in team environments and manage multiple priorities

• Foundational knowledge of AI concepts, machine learning basics, or policy frameworks is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

• CompTIA Security+, CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), or equivalent cybersecurity certification

• Previous experience in training delivery, instructional design, or corporate training environments

• Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC standards

What We Offer

• Professional Development: Comprehensive training and certification support to advance your cybersecurity expertise and career growth

• Collaborative Culture: Work alongside experienced security professionals and contribute to meaningful projects that impact organizational security posture

• Flexible Work Environment: Access to modern tools and resources to deliver effective training across multiple formats

• Career Advancement: Clear pathways to grow from entry-level trainer to senior training specialist or security specialist roles

Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Data Privacy Trainer to join our Cybersecurity & Compliance team as an intern. In this entry-level role, you will develop and deliver engaging training programs on data privacy best practices, compliance regulations, and security awareness to employees across the organization. This is an excellent opportunity to launch your cybersecurity career while making a meaningful impact on organizational security culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop data privacy training materials, including presentations, documentation, and interactive modules aligned with industry standards and regulatory requirements

  • Deliver engaging training sessions to diverse employee groups, ensuring clear communication of complex compliance concepts and privacy principles

  • Assist in conducting privacy impact assessments and compliance audits to identify training gaps and opportunities for improvement

  • Support the creation and maintenance of privacy policies and procedures documentation

  • Track training completion rates and effectiveness metrics, providing reports and recommendations to senior compliance staff

  • Stay current with evolving data protection regulations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA) and incorporate updates into training programs

Required Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in or recently completed a degree program in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Business, Law, or related field

  • Strong understanding of data privacy principles, compliance frameworks, and regulatory requirements

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment

  • Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals and information security best practices

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CIPP/US, or CompTIA Security+ in progress or completed

  • Previous experience in training delivery, instructional design, or compliance-related roles

  • Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS) and training development tools

What We Offer

  • Professional Development: Hands-on experience in cybersecurity and compliance with mentorship from industry experts, helping you build a strong foundation for your career

  • Flexible Learning Environment: Exposure to real-world compliance challenges and the opportunity to earn industry-recognized certifications with company support

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive hourly rate and potential for conversion to full-time opportunities based on performance

  • Collaborative Culture: Work alongside dedicated security professionals in a supportive environment that values innovation and continuous learning

Overview

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Cybersecurity Intern to join our Security Operations team. This entry-level position offers hands-on experience in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating cybersecurity threats. You will work alongside experienced security professionals to support our organization's mission of protecting critical assets and data from evolving cyber threats.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in monitoring network traffic and security logs to identify suspicious activities and potential security incidents

  • Support vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities under the guidance of senior security staff

  • Help maintain and update security documentation, policies, and incident response procedures

  • Participate in security awareness training initiatives and support user education programs

  • Conduct preliminary analysis of security alerts and escalate findings to appropriate team members

  • Assist with security tool configuration, deployment, and maintenance across the organization

Required Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in or recently completed an undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field

  • Strong foundational knowledge of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS) and operating systems (Windows, Linux)

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity principles including encryption, authentication, and access control

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment

  • Strong communication skills and attention to detail

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CompTIA Network+, or CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)

  • Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) platforms or intrusion detection systems

  • Hands-on experience with penetration testing tools or vulnerability scanning software

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive mentorship from experienced cybersecurity professionals in a collaborative environment

  • Practical exposure to industry-standard security tools and technologies

  • Flexible work arrangements to accommodate academic schedules

  • Competitive internship compensation and potential for full-time conversion upon successful completion

Overview
We are seeking a motivated VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing) Analyst to join our cybersecurity team. In this entry-level role, you will conduct security assessments, identify vulnerabilities, and provide actionable recommendations to strengthen our clients' security posture. This is an excellent opportunity to launch your career in ethical hacking and penetration testing while working alongside experienced security professionals.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform vulnerability assessments and penetration tests on client networks, applications, and infrastructure using industry-standard tools

• Identify, document, and classify security vulnerabilities with detailed severity ratings and business impact analysis

• Develop and execute test plans based on client requirements and scope definitions

• Create comprehensive penetration testing reports with findings, evidence, and remediation recommendations

• Communicate technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders in a clear and professional manner

• Assist in vulnerability remediation efforts and conduct retesting to verify fixes

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)

• Strong foundational knowledge of networking, operating systems, and web application security

• Hands-on experience with penetration testing tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, or similar platforms

• Solid understanding of common vulnerabilities including OWASP Top 10, SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and privilege escalation

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to document findings professionally

Preferred Qualifications

• CompTIA Security+, CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker), or OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) certification

• Previous internship or practical experience in cybersecurity, penetration testing, or security operations

• Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell

What We Offer

• Professional Development: Comprehensive training program, certification sponsorship, and mentorship from senior security professionals to accelerate your career growth

• Competitive Compensation: Attractive salary package with performance bonuses and benefits

• Career Growth: Clear advancement opportunities within our growing cybersecurity division with exposure to diverse projects and clients

• Collaborative Environment: Work with a talented team of security experts in a supportive, innovation-driven culture

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a seasoned Cybersecurity & ISMS Lead Consultant to join our annual GRC engagement as a dedicated resource. You will own end-to-end ISO 27001:2022 internal audit delivery across two full cycles per year and lead the HIPAA Security Rule risk analysis — functioning as an embedded extension of the client's compliance and security team.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•     Plan and execute two complete ISO 27001:2022 internal audit cycles per year (H1 & H2), covering Clauses 4–10 and all applicable Annex A controls

•     Conduct document reviews, process walkthroughs, structured interviews, and technical evidence sampling (access logs, vulnerability scans, change records, backup logs)

•     Classify findings as Major NC / Minor NC / Observation / OFI; issue draft and final audit reports with executive summaries

•     Manage a live CAPA log — tracking root causes, corrective actions, owners, due dates, and closure verification across audit cycles

•     Conduct annual HIPAA Security Rule risk analysis covering administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for ePHI

•     Produce a Risk Management Plan and security incident procedure gap assessment

•     Review contingency plans: data backup, disaster recovery, and emergency mode operations

•     Lead closing meetings and post-audit debriefs with CISO and senior management; participate in monthly check-ins and quarterly business reviews (QBR)

•     Respond to urgent compliance queries within 8 business hours; available Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm IST

 •     Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in information security and GRC

•     Proven track record conducting ISO 27001 internal/external audits across technology, financial services, healthcare, or professional services

•     Strong knowledge of HIPAA Security Rule safeguards and risk analysis methodology

•     Deep expertise in audit methodology, IS control testing, evidence evaluation, and risk-based audit approach

•     Ability to translate complex security findings into board-ready insights and actionable remediation plans

•     Comfortable managing CAPA lifecycles and conducting CAPA verification across audit cycles

 

AVAILABILITY COMMITMENT

•     Audit windows blocked in advance; no competing assignments during fieldwork periods

•     4-hour response for compliance-critical queries during active audit periods

•     Backup: qualified ISO 27001 Lead Auditor of equivalent seniority assigned in case of unforeseen unavailability

Overview
We are seeking a motivated API Security Engineer to join our cybersecurity team. In this entry-level role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and mitigating security vulnerabilities in application programming interfaces. You will work alongside experienced security professionals to protect our systems and ensure secure API implementations across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct security testing and vulnerability assessments on APIs to identify potential threats and weaknesses

• Develop and execute API security test cases and penetration testing scenarios

• Document findings and create detailed reports with remediation recommendations for development teams

• Collaborate with software developers to implement security best practices and fix identified vulnerabilities

• Monitor API security logs and alerts to detect suspicious activities or potential breaches

• Participate in code reviews with a focus on security implications and compliance requirements

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or related field

• Strong foundational knowledge of API architecture, REST, and web services security

• Understanding of common API vulnerabilities including injection attacks, authentication flaws, and data exposure risks

• Proficiency with security testing tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or Postman

• Knowledge of HTTP protocols, SSL/TLS, OAuth, and API authentication mechanisms

Preferred Qualifications

• CompTIA Security+ certification or equivalent security credential

• Experience with OWASP API Security Top 10 and industry security frameworks

• Familiarity with scripting languages such as Python or JavaScript for security automation

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision coverage

• Professional development opportunities with access to training, certifications, and cybersecurity conferences

• Collaborative work environment with mentorship from experienced security professionals

• Flexible work arrangements and a supportive company culture focused on innovation and continuous learning

We are hiring a specialist Privacy & Data Protection Lead Consultant to deliver a continuous, year-round compliance programme across GDPR, DPDP 2023 (India), and the HIPAA Privacy Rule. You will serve as a trusted advisor to the client's DPO and legal counsel, embedding privacy practice into their operations — not as an annual tick-box exercise, but as a living programme.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Objective: As a Senior SOC Analyst at Zaptune, you are responsible for leading the defence of the enterprise infrastructure through advanced threat detection, incident response, and proactive security engineering. - **Advanced Incident Response:** Investigate and respond to escalated security incidents, including ransomware, advanced malware, sophisticated phishing, and insider threats.

- **Automation & Optimization:** Develop and automate SOC workflows and incident response playbooks to improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Respond (MTTR).
  
- **Reporting & Compliance:** Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and prepare detailed technical reports for stakeholders, ensuring compliance with auditing standards

projects.title: SAP GRC Project
projects.description:
I am an SAP Security and GRC Analyst  of hands-on experience in delivering secure, compliant, and efficient SAP environments. My expertise spans across user administration, role design, authorization management, and security troubleshooting across ECC, BW, CRM, FIORI, and GRC modules.

I have been actively involved in GRC Access Control (ARM, ARA, EAM) for access risk analysis, firefighter management, and SOD analysis. I focus on building robust access controls and minimizing risks while enabling smooth business operations.

Known for my analytical approach, attention to detail, and commitment to quality delivery, I collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to meet audit requirements and enhance security posture.

projects.title: Nyrstar Business Systems
projects.description: Nyrstar handles end to end operations in Mining and Metals industries and our responsibility is to manage the Security and Audits of the organisation via SAP.
highlights: Reduces Risks and performed Enhancements

projects.title: Role design
projects.description: SAP role design and Authorization

projects.title: SOC Analyst Home Lab Environment
projects.description:
Designed and building a multi-machine cybersecurity lab environment to simulate real-world enterprise SOC monitoring and detection workflows.

Environment includes:

• pfSense firewall/router for network segmentation and traffic control
• Suricata IDS/IPS for intrusion detection and alert generation
• Wazuh SIEM for centralized log collection and security monitoring
• Kali Linux for authorized security testing scenarios
• Windows Server Active Directory domain environment
• Windows 10 endpoint system for user activity simulation
• Vulnerable lab machines for controlled attack simulations

Project focus:

• Log analysis and alert triage workflows
• Network traffic analysis using Wireshark
• Threat detection aligned with MITRE ATT&CK techniques
• Understanding attacker behavior in safe lab environments
• Building foundational SOC analyst skills

Purpose:
Develop hands-on experience with tools and processes used by real Security Operations Centers (SOC) to detect, investigate, and respond to threats.

projects.title: SentinelGuard – Endpoint Security Monitoring Tool
projects.description:
Designed and developing SentinelGuard, a security-focused endpoint monitoring application that simulates advanced host-based detection and response capabilities.

The project focuses on identifying suspicious system activity, monitoring processes, tracking persistence mechanisms, and analyzing potential security threats in real time.

Key security capabilities include:

• Process monitoring and behavioral analysis
• Detection of suspicious persistence mechanisms
• System activity logging and audit trail generation
• Monitoring startup items and system changes
• Security-focused event tracking
• Risk scoring concepts for threat prioritization
• Defensive security engineering design principles
• Secure software architecture practices

SentinelGuard is being built to demonstrate practical knowledge of endpoint security concepts used in EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) tools and modern defensive security platforms.

The project emphasizes:

• Secure coding practices
• Detection-focused design thinking
• Visibility into system behavior
• Threat detection logic development
• Building security tools for defensive use cases

Purpose:
Develop hands-on experience designing security-focused software and understanding how endpoint detection tools identify suspicious activity in enterprise environments.
highlights: Built endpoint monitoring prototype
Designed security-focused architecture
Implemented activity logging system
Practicing secure coding principles
Studying EDR concepts
Developing detection logic mindset

projects.title: Secure Enterprise Network Design & Segmentation
projects.description: Designed a scalable and secure enterprise network architecture for a multi-campus university environment, focusing on network segmentation, secure routing, and access control. The design supports efficient traffic management, centralized services, and future SOC integration.
highlights: Implemented department-based VLAN segmentation to isolate traffic and reduce attack surface
Designed hierarchical-star topology (core, distribution, access layers) for scalability and fault isolation
Applied least privilege firewall rules and access control policies
Configured secure routing with OSPF and authentication mechanisms
Integrated disaster recovery architecture with isolated traffic paths
Planned for future SOC integration (SIEM, IDS/IPS, centralized logging)

projects.title: Linux Adminstration & Automation Design
projects.description: Configured and managed a Linux environment as part of a Computer Systems project, focusing on system setup, administration, and automation. Implemented user management, permission controls, task scheduling via cron, and basic security measures to ensure system stability and maintain a controlled lab environment. Developed scripts to automate repetitive tasks and monitored system logs to troubleshoot and maintain the environment efficiently.
highlights: Linux Environment Design – Created a detailed blueprint for a Linux system, including user roles, permission schemes, and system architecture.
Automation Planning – Designed automation workflows using Bash scripting and cron job scheduling to streamline routine tasks in the proposed environment.
System Monitoring & Logging – Documented monitoring strategies, log analysis approaches, and troubleshooting procedures for maintaining system health.
Comprehensive Documentation – Produced clear, structured documentation of the environment, including diagrams, configuration plans, and operational procedures, suitable for practical implementation.
Linux Environment Simulation – Modeled a realistic Linux setup to demonstrate understanding of Linux administration principles and workflows.

projects.title: Cybersecurity Dashboard for Web Threat Monitoring
projects.description: Developed a cybersecurity dashboard to monitor web traffic and identify vulnerabilities such as XSS and SQL Injection. Analyzed HTTP requests and server responses to detect suspicious activities, integrated log data for centralized monitoring, and built visualizations for effective security analysis. Performed network traffic analysis and vulnerability identification using industry tools
highlights: Detected web vulnerabilities like XSS and SQL Injection
Det Built a real-time cybersecurity monitoring dashboard

projects.title: Network_packet_Analyzer_Tool
projects.description:
The Network Packet Analyzer is a Python-based tool designed to capture, inspect, and analyze network traffic in real time. Using Scapy for packet sniffing and Tkinter for a user-friendly GUI, the analyzer provides a detailed view of network communication happening on your system.
A Windows-compatible GUI-based Network Packet Sniffer built using Python, Tkinter, and Scapy. This tool allows users to capture, inspect, and analyze live network packets in real time through an easy-to-use graphical interface.
highlights: Networking Security

projects.title: Firewall Policy Simulator
projects.description: Firewall Policy Simulator is a Python-based GUI tool built with Tkinter that allows users to create, save, load, and simulate firewall rules in an easy-to-use graphical interface. It helps cybersecurity learners and professionals understand how firewalls filter packets based on defined policies such as source IP, destination IP, port, protocol, and action (ALLOW/DENY).
highlights: Rapid GUI Prototyping with Tkinter
Logic-Driven Packet Filtering
Intuitive State Management

projects.title: Password-Complexity-checker
projects.description: The Password Complexity Checker acts as a real-time auditor for user credentials. It provides immediate feedback on whether a password is "Weak," "Medium," or "Strong" based on a set of predefined heuristic rules. This is a fundamental component of Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems.

projects.title: Av automated pentest using openclaw
projects.description: Automated penetration testing is a modern approach used to evaluate the security of systems by simulating cyberattacks through specialized tools such as OpenClaw. Unlike manual testing, automated pentesting allows organizations to quickly scan networks, applications, and systems for vulnerabilities with minimal human intervention. This makes the process faster, more consistent, and suitable for large-scale environments.

projects.title: SOC-Threat-Analysis-Project
projects.description: Conducted Security Operations Center (SOC) threat analysis by investigating real-world cyber attack scenarios including malware infections and phishing attempts. Analyzed system logs and network traffic to identify suspicious activities and indicators of compromise (IOCs). Performed incident response by detecting, analyzing, and mitigating threats using security tools and techniques. Documented findings with detailed reports and recommended security improvements to strengthen system defenses

projects.title: PTAIO - Penetration Testing All in One
projects.description: PTAIO is a comprehensive penetration testing tool that combines multiple security testing functionalities into a single, user-friendly interface. It's designed for various phases of ethical hacking, including reconnaissance, vulnerability assessment, exploitation, and post-exploitation

projects.title: Vulnhunter-AI-Agentic-Penetration-Testing-Framework
projects.description: This framework that leverages agentic AI to automate vulnerability assessment, exploit chain analysis, and professional reporting. Designed to overcome the limitations of traditional scanners.

projects.title: subenum
projects.description: A CLI-based tool for subdomain enumeration, liveness detection, IP classification, and Shodan integration

projects.title: ChromePass-Harvester
projects.description:
Automate Chrome credential extraction silently using ChromePass.exe — Offensive Security Research Tool

This repository contains a VBS automation script that automates the harvesting of saved Google Chrome passwords from a Windows system using ChromePass.

Designed for post-exploitation scenarios where access to a target system is already established, and rapid credential extraction is required:

Runs ChromePass silently without any GUI interaction.
Automatically searches for ChromePass.exe in the Downloads folder.
Extracts all saved Chrome passwords across profiles.
Saves output to a TXT file in an auto-created folder.
Requests admin privileges via UAC for proper execution.
Includes full error handling and user feedback at every step.

projects.title: Omni-Scanner
projects.description:
Omni-Scanner is a Python-based, easy-to-use network scanner that helps you detect devices, analyze network paths, and run advanced scans. Designed for ethical hacking, learning, and securing your own network.

🚀 Features
🕵️ Device Discovery — Find devices on your local network with ARP scans
📡 Custom Ping Options — Perform simple or flood pings, and check latency
🗺️ Traceroute — Visualize the route your packets take
🔦 Advanced Scanning — Integrates with Nmap for OS detection and stealth scanning

projects.title: Role of RegTech in Automating Information Security Compliance: A Use Case Based Study
projects.description:
I have developed a functional prototype of a RegTech Compliance Automation Platform to demonstrate the practical application of my research.
The tool is a standalone web application that runs directly in any browser by just opening the HTML file — no installation required.
It has 7 modules:
Dashboard — shows real-time compliance scores across 5 regulatory frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, SOX, PCI-DSS, and NIST CSF. You can select any framework and run a compliance scan.
Control Matrix — shows each individual regulatory control, whether it is automated or manual, its compliance status, risk level, and evidence collected.
Risk Register — automatically generates a list of risks from the control gaps identified, exactly how a real RegTech platform works.
Audit Trail — shows a timestamped log of all compliance events, demonstrating how RegTech creates continuous automated evidence for regulators and auditors.
Framework Map — shows how controls map across all 5 frameworks side by side.
ROI Calculator — models the financial return of implementing RegTech in a bank. You can adjust sliders for number of staff, salary, penalty risk, and platform cost — and it instantly shows annual savings, 5-year ROI, payback period, and cost breakdown by activity.
AI Advisor — this module is powered by the Anthropic Claude AI API and allows users to ask any compliance or RegTech related question and get expert answers.
highlights: The tool is a standalone web application that runs directly in any browser by just opening the HTML file — no installation required.

projects.title: S3-Bucket-Scanner
projects.description:
S3 Bucket Listener or Cloud ACL Check Detector is an advanced autonomous security agent designed to discover, audit, and analyze cloud storage assets (AWS S3, GCP Storage, Azure Blob).

Unlike standard scanners that rely solely on name permutations, this agent utilizes OSINT techniques (Source Code Scraping, CNAME Fingerprinting) to find hidden buckets, analyzes their ACL policies, and provides a Grouped File Management System for safe data exfiltration and auditing.

projects.title: web security toolkit
projects.description:
Developed an advanced Web Security Toolkit designed to automate web application security assessment and vulnerability detection. The project provides a centralized platform for identifying common web vulnerabilities, performing security analysis, and generating actionable reports through an interactive dashboard.

Key Features:
Developed automated vulnerability scanning modules for detecting SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), security misconfigurations, and sensitive file exposure
Implemented directory enumeration, HTTP security header analysis, and basic reconnaissance capabilities
Built a responsive dashboard with real-time scan results, vulnerability statistics, risk scoring, and security analytics
Integrated logging and reporting mechanisms for vulnerability tracking and assessment
Created modular scanning engines using Python to improve scalability and maintainability
Added visualization features including threat analytics, severity categorization, and scan history tracking
highlights: 13 modular security scanners (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, etc.) with multi-threaded engine, interactive dashboard, PDF/JSON reports, and Docker deployment — all in a Flask web app.
